name: What should I prepare before contacting a real estate agent for an oceanfront condo search?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a real estate agent for an oceanfront condo search?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a real estate agent like Kelby Contreras, it's beneficial to have a clear understanding of your budget, desired location (e.g., specific cities like Miami Beach, Boca Raton, or Fort Lauderdale Beach), and a list of 'must-have' features. Consider your preferred lifestyle – do you want a bustling urban environment or a quieter retreat? Having pre-approved financing or proof of funds for cash purchases is also highly advantageous. This preparation helps your agent efficiently narrow down suitable options and streamline your search for the ideal oceanfront condo.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting an agent, prepare your budget, desired location, 'must-have' features, preferred lifestyle, and pre-approved financing to streamline your oceanfront condo search.
